verdict.rationale: The evidence shows Helicone logs requests automatically and that its AI Gateway supports image generation. Nothing documents capturing or rendering multimodal payloads (images, audio, files) inside logged traces or sessions. Image-generation routing is a related gateway feature, not trace capture of multimodal content, so it earns no credit for this story.

support.subject: As a developer, I can capture multimodal payloads (images, audio, files) inside my traces
